lines.zh: 关节在响，我一步一步过去。
lines.en: My joints creak with every step I take.
My hook hangs at my side.
The floorboards groan under me.

lines.zh: 我走得很快，因为我认准了方向。
lines.en: I walk fast, because I know where I'm going.
My strides are long and not quite steady.
My fabric scrapes along the corner.
I round the table and head straight over.
My one eye never looks away from ahead.
Gears turn inside my chest.

lines.zh: 我不躲藏，我直接走过去。
lines.en: I don't hide; I just walk over.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和你不一样，更重。
lines.en: My steps are heavier than yours.

lines.zh: 我把钩子在手指上敲了一下。
lines.en: I tap my hook against a finger.
I tilt my head and listen.
My jaw hangs, unable to close.
I stand in the dark and wait.

lines.zh: 我的布上有一道海蓝色的痕。
lines.en: There's a sea-blue streak on my cloth.
I stare at a shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 我的手指一下一下地颤。
lines.en: My fingers twitch, one by one.

lines.zh: 胸腔里有一下没一下的响。
lines.en: Something clicks in my chest, off and on.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，可我还是停着。
lines.en: I don't breathe, yet I still pause.

lines.zh: 我把钩子举起来，又放下。
lines.en: I raise the hook, then lower it.

lines.zh: 你不是怪物，那你站远点。
lines.en: You're not a monster, so keep back.
I only chase what's meant to be chased.
Your heartbeat is far too even.
You watch me, and I watch you.
Don't stand in my path.
I can tell the living from the monstrous.
Interfere, and I won't be gentle.
My hook isn't for you.

lines.zh: 你身后的东西，我看见了。
lines.en: I see what's behind you.
A dent in the shell; the gears still turn.
I sway once and straighten up.
The fabric tore; iron shows beneath.
My movement slows for an instant.
It isn't pain; something's just wrong.
My jaw has come loose again.
I step back half a pace and re-align.

lines.zh: 关节里卡进了一点东西。
lines.en: Something's wedged in a joint.
I shake until it falls out.
I can still get up and chase.

lines.zh: 我要的是它，不是你手里那些
lines.en: I want it, not what is in your hands
That means nothing to me.
I only want the target over there.

lines.zh: 我的肚子是空的，里面只有齿轮。
lines.en: My belly is empty; there are only gears in it.
Food won't calm me.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是另一种味道。
lines.en: What I smell is something else.
I'm not hungry; I'm simply not tired.
Keep it, human.
You bump me; my shell is hard.
You knocked me off line; I reset my stance.

lines.zh: 我的钩子挂到你的袖子。
lines.en: My hook snags your sleeve.
Not so near; I might hit wrong.
I gave no ground; you stepped back.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀发出咔的一声。
lines.en: My shoulder cracks audibly.
We squeeze through that doorway together.
You've smudged my fabric.
Move; I'm far heavier than you.
All four of us are here.
They stand on the stage, saying nothing.
I know the sound of their steps.
We don't even look at each other.
Our shells are all hard.
We each have our own corner.
I hear it walking on the other side.
We don't team up; we patrol apart.
Someone moved my curtain.
I keep the hook behind me.
I pick up the strip of cloth.
I'll keep the iron nail for my shell.

lines.zh: 我的手指太僵，捡得很慢。
lines.en: My fingers are stiff; I pick it up slowly.
This smells of oil.
I tuck it into my chest cavity.

lines.zh: 我捡起一段断掉的皮带。
lines.en: I pick up a snapped strap.
These scraps I'll keep for spares.

lines.zh: 这副钩子，顺手捡点战利品。
lines.en: This hook of mine picks up a little loot along the way.
That monster over there isn't getting away.
My single eye locks on.
It moved, so I move.
I recognize that stink of rot.
The hook is up.
It's shorter than me. Easier.
No shouting; I just go.
My pace jumps all at once.
This time I'll catch it.

lines.zh: 墙后面的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the sound behind the wall.
It thinks I can't see it.
I'll block the doorway.
Locked on; now I walk.
It turns a corner; I go straight on.
I turn the hook crosswise.
It's hiding under a table.
I can wait longer than it can.
Its claws scrape on the stone.

lines.zh: 它退到船板边，没有路了
lines.en: It backs to the edge of the planks with nowhere left
Its breathing is rapid.
It's testing me.
I don't stop, and I don't need rest.
This distance needs only one swing.
It's backing up the stairs.
My gears turn faster and faster.
It has no way out.
It's hidden in the cabinet.
I pull the door open.
A few paces; I can reach it.
Its shadow shrinks to a knot.
This is nearly over.
The hook comes down hard.
One punch knocks it over.
It hits the wall and slides down.
My hook catches it.
That wasn't full force.
I throw it clear across the room.
My jaw snaps shut.
It can't work free of my grip.
Whatever's on the floor scatters.
It makes an ugly sound.
There's no hesitation in this shell.
It tries to crawl; I hold it down.
I raise the hook.
It has stopped moving.
Whose turn is next?
My fingers open.
I step back and smooth my cloth.

lines.zh: 我的钩子手垂着，刚收回。
lines.en: My hook hand hangs loose, just pulled back.
Its kin will come.
I appear from behind the curtain.
My single eye flickers on.

lines.zh: 地板响了一声，我就到了。
lines.en: The floor creaks once, and I'm here.
I know this room.
First I turn my head and sweep the room.
The hook swings at my side.

lines.zh: 我不需要谁把我放出来。
lines.en: I don't need anyone to let me out.
The stage lights are still on.

lines.zh: 帘子还在晃，我已经站好
lines.en: The curtain still sways; I am already in place

lines.zh: 我站在这里，等一个目标。
lines.en: I stand here, waiting for a target.
There's a layer of dust on my fabric.
I step out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 火烧到布面，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my fabric; I swat it twice.
I fall down the steps and my shell clangs.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的壳里，我在短路。
lines.en: Water gets in my shell; I'm shorting out.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的布掀开一半。
lines.en: The blast peels half my cloth away.

lines.zh: 一颗子弹钻进了我的肩。
lines.en: A bullet buries itself in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光让我的齿轮停了。
lines.en: Strange light stops my gears.

lines.zh: 我不用吃饭，可我现在很迟钝。
lines.en: I don't eat, yet I've grown sluggish.

lines.zh: 雷过电，我的独眼灭了一下。
lines.en: Lightning shorts me and my eye blinks out.

lines.zh: 这里没有地板，我找不到支撑。
lines.en: No floor here; nothing to stand on.
